stem: How do lines 17 through 19 contribute to the falling action in the poem?

options.label: A
options.text: They indicate that March's work is completed.

options.label: B
options.text: They show that March has no more strength to continue.

options.label: C
options.text: They highlight that April will be around longer than March.

options.label: D
options.text: They reveal that April and March work together to end winter.
